shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated short vertical strokes / rectangular units
figures arranged in stacked horizontal registers
schematic animal or quadruped forms (stick-legged in A, relief-modelled in B)
curved elongated forms with projecting appendages
justification: The clearest correspondence is the organisation of motifs into stacked horizontal registers, with each surface carrying a band of repeated short vertical strokes or rectangular units, plus small discs and schematic animal/limbed forms. Everything else diverges: A is thin red linear painting on an uneven natural rock face dominated by curved boat-like hulls and stick figures, while B is deeply carved three-dimensional relief of modelled beasts on a dressed rectangular pillar, so the manner of execution has essentially nothing in common.
